description: The line plot illustrates the performance of various models during fine-tuning for abstractive summarization from audio transcription, with the metric WER (Word Error Rate) plotted against the number of epochs. The x-axis represents the epoch, ranging from 0 to 6 in integer steps, while the y-axis shows the WER, ranging from 30 to 70. The legend identifies five different models: "tiny AdaLoRA_int4" (solid line with circle markers), "tiny AdaLoRA_int8" (solid line with square markers), "tiny int4" (dashed line with circle markers), "tiny int8" (dashed line with square markers), and "tiny" (dotted line with triangle markers). All models exhibit a general downward trend in WER as the number of epochs increases. At epoch 0, the "tiny AdaLoRA_int4" model starts with the highest WER, approximately 69, while the "tiny" model starts with the lowest WER, around 29. By epoch 6, the "tiny AdaLoRA_int4" model's WER decreases to approximately 40, and the "tiny" model's WER stabilizes around 23. The "tiny AdaLoRA_int8" and "tiny int8" models show similar trends, with WERs decreasing from approximately 60 and 50 respectively at epoch 0 to around 36 and 37 at epoch 6. The "tiny int4" model's WER decreases from about 55 to 39 over the same period. The "tiny" model consistently maintains the lowest WER throughout the training process.
